summary.en: Separate public declarations from private definitions, build several translation units, and express rebuild rules with make.
summary.bn: হেডারে declaration রাখো, সোর্স ফাইলে implementation লেখো এবং make দিয়ে দরকারি অংশ আবার build করো।

sections.title: Give each part of a growing program a clear home
Declare an interface once and implement it once
From translation units to one executable
Build clients with small, explicit interfaces
Repair the boundary that actually failed
Choose an interface that callers can trust
C interfaces and a separate build tool

examples.title: Compile a client and marks module as separate sources
examples.explanationHtml: The header declares passed_count. marks.c defines it and keeps is_pass private with static. The four marks contain two passes. The project directory also contains a Makefile for separate compilation.

examples.title: Include a guarded declaration twice without redefining it
examples.explanationHtml: The include guard makes the second inclusion harmless. Guarding a header does not make arbitrary function definitions safe across different source files; this header contains a declaration only.

examples.title: Keep same-named helper functions private to their source files
examples.explanationHtml: Both source files define adjustment, but each definition has internal linkage. Their public wrappers call their own helper. Removing static from both helpers would create competing external definitions rather than a shared choice at runtime.

practice.title: Reuse the public pass-count interface
practice.statementHtml: Read n from 0 to 10 followed by n marks from 0 to 100. Print the number at least 40. Use the supplied marks module, check all input and print invalid on invalid data.
hints: Validate before calling the counting function.

practice.title: Build a client around a range predicate
practice.statementHtml: Read value, low and high as integers from -1000 to 1000. Print inside if low ≤ high and value is in the inclusive interval; otherwise print outside. Print invalid for missing input. Keep the predicate in range.c.
hints: The header must match the function definition.

practice.title: Explain which objects rebuild after a header edit
practice.statementHtml: For the included Makefile, identify the commands needed after changing only main.c, only marks.c, or marks.h.
hints: Read prerequisites rather than guessing from executable output.
practice.answerHtml: Changing main.c rebuilds main.o and relinks marks-demo. Changing marks.c rebuilds marks.o and relinks. Changing marks.h makes both object targets out of date, so both compile again before linking. This works because both rules list the header explicitly. A later make with no changed prerequisite runs no recipe.

practice.title: Repair an accidental shared definition
practice.statementHtml: A header contains int total = 0; and is included by two source files. Propose a single-definition repair and a design with no shared mutable global.
hints: An include guard applies separately in each translation unit.
practice.answerHtml: Put extern int total; in the guarded header and exactly one int total = 0; definition in a source file. Both clients then refer to that object. Prefer an explicit state structure passed to functions when possible: it makes ownership visible and supports independent instances. Do not assume a header guard prevents definitions in different translation units.

options: A source file after preprocessing its includes
quiz.explanation: Each .c file is compiled with its included declarations before linking.

quiz.prompt: Why should marks.c include its own public header?
options: To compare its definition with its promised declaration
quiz.explanation: A conflicting signature can then be diagnosed in the implementation translation unit.

options: An object file without linking an executable
quiz.explanation: Separate compilation creates marks.o; linking combines object files.

quiz.prompt: What does file-scope static do to adjustment?
options: Makes it callable from every file
quiz.explanation: Other translation units cannot name this function as an external definition.

quiz.prompt: Why are ordinary function definitions usually excluded from public headers?
options: Each including translation unit could define the same external function
quiz.explanation: Put the declaration in the header and one definition in a .c file.

quiz.prompt: Which Makefile character normally starts a recipe line?
quiz.explanation: The provided Makefile uses real tabs before compiler recipes.

quiz.prompt: What does an undefined-reference linker error commonly mean?
options: The function ran and returned zero
A declared function has no linked definition
The source has too many comments
quiz.explanation: Check missing object files and spelling before changing runtime logic.

quiz.prompt: Does a header guard coordinate definitions between separate .c files?
options: No, preprocessing starts independently for each translation unit
Yes, it shares macros between compiler processes
Only when the header is empty
quiz.explanation: It prevents repeated content within one translation unit.

quiz.prompt: What does a block-scope shadow change in this private-helper example?
quiz.explanation: The inner block has its own object; the outer value remains three.

quiz.prompt: How does one static local counter behave across calls in a single module?
quiz.explanation: The local object persists, while function-level static controls linkage; these are distinct uses.

quiz.prompt: What happens when a guarded macro block is encountered twice?
quiz.explanation: The second conditional block is skipped because the guard macro is already defined.

keyPoints.en: Headers describe public interfaces; source files provide their definitions.
keyPoints.bn: হেডারে public interface জানাও, সোর্স ফাইলে তার definition রাখো।

keyPoints.en: Include the public header in the implementation to check agreement.
keyPoints.bn: Implementation-এ নিজের হেডার include করো, যাতে declaration-এর মিল যাচাই হয়।

keyPoints.en: File-scope static hides implementation helpers from other translation units.
keyPoints.bn: ফাইলের বাইরে helper দরকার না হলে static দিয়ে সেটি private রাখো।

keyPoints.en: Compile each translation unit, then link all required objects.
keyPoints.bn: প্রতিটি সোর্স compile করার পর দরকারি object একসঙ্গে link করো।

keyPoints.en: Header dependencies are necessary for reliable incremental builds.
keyPoints.bn: হেডার বদলালে সঠিক অংশ rebuild করতে dependency লিখে রাখো।

keyPoints.en: A header guard does not solve multiple external definitions across files.
keyPoints.bn: আলাদা সোর্স ফাইলে একই external definition থাকলে header guard তা সারায় না।

examQuestions.question: Explain the compiler and linker stages for main.c and marks.c.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Preprocess and compile each .c file into its own object with gcc -c. Declarations let the compiler check calls within each translation unit. Link main.o and marks.o to resolve passed_count and produce the executable. Syntax/type errors arise during compilation; a missing marks.o can leave an undefined reference during linking.

examQuestions.question: Why can two files safely use the same static helper name?
examQuestions.answerHtml: At file scope, static gives each function internal linkage. Each name identifies its own translation-unit-local function, so their external symbol definitions do not compete. The public wrapper declarations still need one matching external definition each. This use differs from the persistent storage duration of a block-scope static object.

examQuestions.question: Write rebuild dependencies for a shared header and explain the cost of omitting them.
examQuestions.answerHtml: List main.o: main.c marks.h and marks.o: marks.c marks.h, then list the executable as depending on both objects. Without header prerequisites, make may keep an old object after the interface changes. A successful incremental command can then combine inconsistent code. A clean rebuild can expose the problem but does not replace correct dependency rules.
